camacho--connecticut.description: Camacho's lighter blend, revamped in 2013: an Ecuadorian Connecticut shade wrapper over a Corojo binder and Honduran Generoso and Aleman ligero filler, grown at the brand's Jamastrán farms in Honduras. Creamy and smooth with citrus, hay and cedar, it gains a little pepper and toastiness toward the end, a fitting morning cigar.

thirds.notes: Buttery cream and a bright citrus edge over cedar, hay and a touch of earth.
The citrus recedes; milky coffee, hay and cedar settle in with a little more pepper.
Toasty and creamy, with sweet hay, faint wood and a gentle pepper to close.

sources.title: Mike's Cigars – Camacho brand page
Gotham Cigars – Camacho Connecticut
Bespoke Unit – Camacho Connecticut review
The Cigar Authority – Camacho Connecticut Robusto review

camacho--corojo.description: Camacho's Corojo blend, rolled in Honduras from Corojo tobacco grown in the Jamastrán Valley, where the brand's Corojo was first cultivated from Cuban seed brought out after the revolution. A full, spicy smoke with leather and earth, made for those who like a cigar with plenty of strength.

sources.title: Mike's Cigars – Camacho brand page
The Cigar Authority – Camacho Corojo Robusto review
Bespoke Unit – Camacho Corojo review
Blind Man's Puff – Camacho Corojo BXP Toro review

thirds.notes: Red pepper leads, with a molasses-like sweetness and rosewood that soon fade, and touches of cedar and bitter coffee.
The spice sharpens, with paprika-like heat, coffee grounds, cedar and earth; leather builds in the box-pressed size.
Leather and oak take the lead over lingering pepper and earth, in a thick, smoother smoke.

camacho--ecuador.description: A Camacho blend finished in an Ecuadorian sun-grown wrapper, offered in robusto, toro and gordo sizes as well as tubed and box-pressed versions. It sits alongside the brand's Connecticut, Corojo and Nicaragua lines in the core range.

sources.title: Mike's Cigars – Camacho brand page
Cigarworld – Camacho Ecuador
Cigar Inspector – Camacho Ecuador Robusto review
The Cigar Authority – Camacho Ecuador review

thirds.notes: Strong pepper and leather open, with coffee and a salty edge, then a marzipan-like sweetness joins cedar and a hint of raisin.
Wood takes over as the cedar darkens toward oak, with coffee, spice and dry leather, now smoother and better balanced.
Oak stays in front with pepper and hay, while the finish turns sweeter, with caramel and raisin.

camacho--nicaragua.description: Camacho's Nicaraguan-focused blend, finished in an Ecuadorian wrapper and made in robusto, toro and gran churchill sizes. Medium to full, it is described with dark chocolate and vanilla over a mix of red and white pepper, a rich choice for the evening.

sources.title: Mike's Cigars – Camacho brand page
Blind Man's Puff – Camacho Nicaragua Toro review
JR Cigars Blending Room – Camacho Nicaragua review

thirds.notes: Ground pepper, a molasses-like sweetness, dry cedar and creamy chocolate, with a little char.
The strength builds and the char deepens toward a smoky, barbecue-like note, with red pepper, cocoa, raisin and a hint of oak.
Baking spice and a buttery note linger as the cocoa fades, and citrus, leather, pepper and wood appear.

camacho--broadleaf.description: A Camacho blend built around a dark broadleaf wrapper, made in robusto, toro and gordo sizes. Listed as medium to full in strength, it is one of the brand's core everyday lines next to the Corojo and Triple Maduro.

sources.title: Mike's Cigars – Camacho brand page
Blind Man's Puff – Camacho Broadleaf Toro review
Smoke Inn – Camacho Broadleaf review

thirds.notes: Creamy cocoa and soft earth with a floral wood note and a light black pepper; coffee, leather and cream for some tasters.
Earth and cocoa continue with floral cedar and peppercorn as the fruity sweetness fades; spice and leather grow.
Wood and dry cream lead, with nuttiness, cedar, white pepper and a hint of clove on the retrohale.

camacho--triple-maduro.description: Part of Camacho's Master Built series, this blend is presented as an all-maduro cigar, with dark, fermented leaf in the wrapper, binder and filler, including a San Andrés wrapper. Full in strength, it suits experienced smokers who want depth and weight.

sources.title: Mike's Cigars – Camacho brand page
The Cigar Authority – Camacho Triple Maduro Toro review
Cigar Inspector – Camacho Triple Maduro review

thirds.notes: Hickory-like earth and rich chocolate open, with leather, dark-roast coffee, wood and a light sweetness.
Black pepper, espresso and cedar join the chocolate, and the sweetness gives way to a savoury, woody core.
Chocolate and coffee dominate over wood, with extra spice and a stronger, fuller finish.

camacho--scorpion-fumas-connecticut.description: A member of Camacho's Scorpion family, made with a Connecticut wrapper and offered in churchill, gordo and robusto sizes. It shares its name with the Scorpion line but is sold separately under the Fumas label.

sources.title: Mike's Cigars – Camacho brand page

camacho--scorpion-fumas-sun-grown.description: The sun-grown member of Camacho's Scorpion Fumas range, offered in churchill, gordo and robusto sizes. It is the darker counterpart to the Scorpion Fumas Connecticut and sits within the brand's Scorpion family.

sources.title: Mike's Cigars – Camacho brand page

camacho--brotherhood-series.description: A run of limited toros from Camacho with military themes: Shellback (2015), Check Six (2016) and Hard Charger. Hard Charger, the third release and a tribute to the Marine Corps, paired a Connecticut broadleaf maduro wrapper with Honduran Corojo binder and filler, smoking peppery and earthy.

sources.title: Mike's Cigars – Camacho brand page
Bespoke Unit – Camacho Hard Charger review

camacho--liberty.description: Camacho's yearly limited release, each edition a new blend and often a new shape, from the 2016 Figurado to the Live Loud Churchill of 2021. The 2015 edition came through the Brotherhood Series to celebrate the Founding Fathers, and some later editions revisited earlier Liberty blends as Throwbacks.

sources.title: Mike's Cigars – Camacho brand page

camacho--scorpion-connecticut.description: A mellow Camacho blend with an Ecuadorian-seed Connecticut wrapper over an aged Honduran binder and long filler. Easygoing in strength yet full of flavour, it moves from spice, leather and cedar toward cocoa and ends creamy and sweet.

thirds.notes: Spice, leather and cedar, with raisin and nut notes in the background.
The spice builds, joined by cocoa and wood over a creamy tobacco sweetness.
The same flavours carry on and the smoke turns especially creamy and sweet.

sources.title: Mike's Cigars – Camacho brand page (discontinued lines)
JR Cigars – Camacho Scorpion Connecticut review

camacho--scorpion-sun-grown.description: The sun-grown counterpart to the Scorpion Connecticut in Camacho's Scorpion family. Camacho still lists it in the current range, alongside the Connecticut version and the Scorpion Fumas bundles.

sources.title: Mike's Cigars – Camacho brand page (discontinued lines)

camacho--factory-unleashed.description: A limited release from Camacho, the Honduran-based brand owned by the Davidoff group, and still listed among its active lines. Little has been published about its blend, so this profile stays brief.

sources.title: Mike's Cigars – Camacho brand page (discontinued lines)
Gotham Cigars – Camacho Connecticut

camacho--10th-anniversary.description: A commemorative Camacho release marking a tenth anniversary, now discontinued. It is listed among the brand's retired lines, and little has been published about its blend.

sources.title: Mike's Cigars – Camacho brand page (discontinued lines)

camacho--american-barrel-aged.description: A discontinued Camacho blend whose name refers to ageing in American barrels. It has been withdrawn from the range, is no longer produced, and little has been published about its blend.

sources.title: Mike's Cigars – Camacho brand page (discontinued lines)

camacho--candela.description: A discontinued Camacho line finished in a green candela wrapper, a leaf cured quickly to keep its colour. It is no longer part of the brand's range.

sources.title: Mike's Cigars – Camacho brand page (discontinued lines)

camacho--corojo-maduro.description: A discontinued maduro version of Camacho's Honduran Corojo blend, the brand's signature tobacco grown in the Jamastrán Valley. It has since left the range, while the natural Corojo remains in production.

sources.title: Mike's Cigars – Camacho brand page (discontinued lines)
Mike's Cigars – Camacho brand page

camacho--criollo.description: A discontinued Camacho blend wrapped in Honduran leaf, reviewed in its 2013 release. Reviewers found it medium to strong at first, with cedar, floral and nutty notes, settling into creamy, salty tobacco with coffee before black pepper took over at the end.

thirds.notes: Cedar and floral tones with cream, nuts and leather, and a broth-like depth.
Sweet tobacco over coffee, with creamy, salty and nutty notes and growing wood smoke.
The earlier flavours intensify and black pepper comes forward, sometimes turning bitter.

sources.title: Mike's Cigars – Camacho brand page (discontinued lines)
Blind Man's Puff – Camacho Criollo Robusto

camacho--ditka-signature.description: A discontinued line from Camacho's Custom Built series, made in honour of the American football coach Mike Ditka. It is no longer produced by the brand.

sources.title: Mike's Cigars – Camacho brand page (discontinued lines)

camacho--double-shock-limited-edition-20.description: A limited Camacho edition released in 2014 under the Double Shock name and since discontinued. It now appears only among the brand's retired lines, and little has been published about its blend.

sources.title: Mike's Cigars – Camacho brand page (discontinued lines)

camacho--nicaraguan-barrel-aged.description: A discontinued Camacho blend whose name points to Nicaraguan tobacco and barrel ageing. It has left the range and is no longer produced by the brand.

sources.title: Mike's Cigars – Camacho brand page (discontinued lines)

camacho--powerband.description: A discontinued Camacho line named after Powerband, the brand's own method of booking filler leaves to give an even draw and balanced burn. It is no longer in production.

sources.title: Mike's Cigars – Camacho brand page (discontinued lines)
Bespoke Unit – Camacho Connecticut review
